hotels.title: Beachfront Moroccan Coastal Hideaway with Four Restaurants, Hammam & Spa
hotels.description: Set on the sun-kissed shores of the Atlantic Ocean, Fairmont Taghazout Bay offers a coastal hideaway with authentic Berber flair. 30 minutes from Agadir, this five-star beachfront haven offers sweeping ocean views, gourmet dining, a world-class spa and access to a pristine private beach - a world away from the everyday. Here, golden sands, glowing sunsets and the sound of rolling waves set the tone for total relaxation. Days begin with mindful yoga sessions, followed by lazy hours by the lagoon-style pool or peaceful strolls along the beach. Unwind at Fairmont Spa Taghazout Bay, where ancient water therapies, blissful massages and traditional hammam rituals await, or tee off at the neighbouring Taghazout Golf Course. As evening falls, savour Japanese or Mediterranean cuisine at one of four onsite restaurants or sip cocktails as the sun sets over the waves.
